title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has responded to a report on artificial intelligence and public standards by committing to develop and implement guidelines to ensure AI is used safely and responsibly in the UK. The response aims to promote public trust in AI technologies and their applications.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education outlines its stance on the use of generative AI in educational settings, providing guidelines and principles for its deployment. This policy aims to balance innovation with student learning and well-being, while considering the potential impact of AI on teaching methods and assessment.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: This policy document outlines Ofqual's approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector. It aims to address concerns related to AI's potential impact on education systems.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report assesses the impact of using copyrighted works in the development of artificial intelligence systems. It focuses on the intersection of copyright law and AI technology.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has issued a response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence's report "AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency". The response outlines the government's plans to address the key recommendations from the report and take further action on artificial intelligence in the UK.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference and frequently asked questions for a review of how artificial intelligence impacts public standards. It provides a framework for exploring the implications of AI in the public sphere.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The CSPL has submitted evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence, likely outlining their views on regulating AI. The submission aims to contribute to the development of effective governance policies for AI.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This AI policy document aims to assess how the increasing use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) affects regulations on medical products. It seeks to implement the principles outlined in the AI White Paper to ensure safety and effectiveness in the development and use of AI in the medical field.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: This Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the defence organisation the world's most effective, efficient, and influential when it comes to AI. The ultimate goal is to achieve a position of global leadership in Defence AI.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport artificial intelligence action plan aims to help the transport sector use AI technologies safely and effectively. It outlines how the Department for Transport (DfT) will work with industries to realize the benefits and minimize the risks of AI.
